page.title: Settings
page.description: Your organization, your team and your account.

whatsappNumber.title: Your WhatsApp number
whatsappNumber.platform: Your WhatsApp messages go out from Jikū's number. Nothing to set up.
whatsappNumber.pitch: Send from your own number: your guests and clients see your name and reply to you directly. Meta bills you for these messages.
whatsappNumber.notIncluded: Your own number is included in Organisation and the Organizer Pack, or available as a monthly add-on.
whatsappNumber.connectHelp: A Meta window opens: choose or create your WhatsApp Business account and number. You need a Meta Business account and a payment method on file with Meta.
whatsappNumber.unavailable: Connecting through Meta is not available yet. You can enter your credentials below.
whatsappNumber.lapsed: Your offer no longer includes your own number: your messages go out from Jikū's number until you renew.
whatsappNumber.disconnected: Your number is disconnected. Your messages go out from Jikū's number.

manual.accessTokenCurrent: Current token: {masked}. Enter a new one to replace it.
manual.phoneNumberIdHelp: The numeric ID of your WhatsApp Business number, in Meta Business Manager.

test.label: Send a test message
test.help: Number in international format, for example +224620000000.

errors.notIncluded: Your offer doesn't include your own WhatsApp number. Add the option from billing.
errors.taken: This number is already connected to another organization.
errors.metaRefused: Meta refused the connection. Try again from the Meta window.
errors.unavailable: Connecting through Meta is not available right now.
errors.failed: We couldn't save your number. Please try again.
errors.sdk: The Meta window couldn't open. Check your connection and try again.

paymentMethods.title: How your clients pay you
paymentMethods.text: When a ticket or appointment isn't free, your clients see these payment methods on their invitation and ticket. Jikū collects nothing: the money goes straight to your accounts.
paymentMethods.payeeNameHelp: The name your clients see on the Mobile Money confirmation. Required if you enter a number.
paymentMethods.paymentLinkHelp: An https:// address to your payment page, if you have one.

errors.failed: We couldn't save your payment methods. Please try again.
errors.verifyFirst: Verify your organization before saving payment methods (Verification tab).

verification.title: Verify your organization
verification.text: Verification is required before you ask clients to pay: paid tickets, paid services or payment methods. It is recommended to every organization, because your guests see that it is verified. A personal or a company verification is enough.

status.verifiedText: You can take payments from your clients, and your guests see the verification badge on your pages.
status.notVerifiedText: Until a verification is approved, you cannot set a price, make a service paid or save payment methods.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.text: We send you a code by SMS to confirm the number you can be reached on. A personal verification needs it.
phone.label: Phone number

personal.title: Personal verification
personal.text: For a person organizing in their own name: an identity document and a confirmed phone number.
personal.needsPhone: Confirm your phone number above first.

company.title: Company verification
company.text: For a company, an association or a venue: its registration papers.

request.submittedOn: Request in the name of {name}, sent on {date}.
request.pendingText: The Jikū team is reviewing your documents, usually within two working days. You will be told the decision.
request.legalNameHelp: Exactly as it appears on the documents.
request.filesHelpPersonal: Front and back of the document, {max} files at most, as JPEG, PNG or PDF. Photos over {size} MB are shrunk automatically.
request.filesHelpCompany: {max} files at most, as JPEG, PNG or PDF, {size} MB each. Heavier photos are shrunk automatically.
request.privacy: Your documents are kept in private storage, read only by the Jikū team for this verification, then deleted: at once if refused, or shortly after approval.
request.submitted: Request sent. We will tell you the decision.

errors.loadFailed: We couldn't load your verification. Reload the page.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
errors.codeNotSent: We couldn't send the code. Try again.
errors.wrongCode: This is not the code we sent.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.incomplete: Check what you entered and try again.
errors.phoneFirstOrPending: Confirm your number, or wait for the decision on the request under review.
errors.alreadyPending: A request is already under review or approved.
errors.fileTooLarge: A file is over the size limit.
errors.fileType: Attach JPEG, PNG or PDF files.
errors.storageUnavailable: Document upload is unavailable for now. Try again later.
errors.failed: We couldn't send your request. Try again.

sales.title: Holding places
sales.text: When a client orders tickets, their places are held while they pay you. Without a declared payment in time, they go back on sale. A declared payment keeps the places until you decide.
sales.holdHelp: Between {min} and {max} minutes. {default} minutes by default.
sales.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number of minutes.
sales.loadFailed: We couldn't load your sales settings.
sales.refused: This hold time is not allowed.

account.description: How you appear in this organization.
